About the desk

Waitlist only. The desk is not accepting paid work.

Stranger Thoughts is a one-person desk. The first version is a waitlist, a public record of attention, and a page with nothing for sale. The person who will read is real. The biography is withheld on purpose.

A human reads the page

Once the waitlist opens and submissions are accepted, a human reads them and writes the reply. The desk does not hand your page to an AI and send back whatever comes out.

Anonymous on purpose

There is no portrait, no legal name, and no military biography. A face can persuade before a sentence has earned anything. The notes under Thoughts are the reputation available today: short, public, and open to your judgment. Later, the replies will add to that record.

If you need a name before you can use a reading, you should wait for a different desk. The sentences here have to be enough.

Standards for a reply

  • Read the whole piece before answering the most quotable line.
  • Say what the writing is doing, not only what it is about.
  • Prefer a specific observation to a compliment.
  • Leave the writer's voice in the writer's mouth.
  • Mark uncertainty in the note itself, in the place where the reading might be wrong.
  • Handwrite when the reply is short enough to mean by hand. Type when the thought needs room or the copy needs to stay clear.
  • Decline work that asks for therapy, a legal opinion, a medical opinion, or a verdict on another person.

What you will get

  • One person's thoughtful reply, once the desk is actually open.
  • A public record of how that person reads, which you can judge before you send anything.
  • A plain refusal when the desk cannot do the thing you asked.

What you will not get

  • A name, a photograph, or a service record.
  • Therapy, crisis care, legal advice, or a medical opinion.
  • A grade, a promise of publication, or a rewrite that replaces your voice.
  • A bill. This version has no prices, no checkout, and no donation box.

If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. In the United States, call or text 988.

Where the notes live

This website is the home of the work. Thoughts are the daily public page. A brand account on X will later share each Thought, without photos, without a location, and without a military unit. No handle is listed until that account is real.
